historical_8941.source: user reported 89.41 DINO / 89.14 FLUX; exact implementation is not on these hosts

baseline: new reproducible C0, not a reproduction of 89.41

dino.features: last post-norm dense patches; exclude model.num_prefix_tokens, no extra L2

qwen_rgb: CAM_F0,CAM_L0,CAM_R0 at decision time, full16:9 source resized1024x576 Lanczos, then unchanged Qwen processor
teacher_rgb: same original full source field, direct bicubic anisotropic resize to specified4:3 dimensions; ImageNet RGB normalization once; no crop/padding
target_pooling: after encoding, separate each view, average nonoverlapping2D blocks, row-major flatten
tokens: current prompt/images, one ego-history token,3 view-major reasoning blocks,8 action tokens; old video/depth/reward suffix removed
attention: Qwen native causal SDPA; action reads all preceding reasoning tokens; no custom bidirectional mask
deployment: retain all reasoning tokens; remove projection head and offline DINO encoder; execute original ego FM output
head: same tokenwise Linear(actual VLM hidden,1024), no spatial cross-attention decoder
loss: ego FM +1.0*current DINO MSE, FP32 valid-element mean; no auxiliary warmup; no future/interaction tasks
initialization: generic VLM only; ego action/state modules, driving token rows, reasoning queries and projection randomly initialized; isolated new-module RNG
fm: original DiT-B24layers width1536,8futurepoints x4, repeat8, Beta(1.5,1), noise_s0.999,10 inference steps,one candidate,no scorer
precision: BF16 student, FP32 AdamW masters/moments and loss
formal_length: PENDING measured P0 throughput and finite budget registration; original config100000 updates,5000warmup is reference
scope: current-only tradeoff; future/GT-MAE matrix not launched
